title: Hexus Salts Blue Razz Lemonade Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blue Razz Lemonade by Hexus blends Blueberry, Raspberry's and Lemonade into a smooth and fruity vape. Blue Razz Lemonade blends the bold, syrupy sweetness of blue raspberry with the sharp, citrus sparkle of classic lemonade. The result is a fizzy, tangy vape that balances rich berry notes with a zesty citrus kick, finishing with a crisp, refreshing exhale. Made with nicotine salts, this e-liquid provides rapid nicotine absorption and a smooth, tactile throat hit. It’s blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it perfect for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, starter devices and vape pens. Part of the Hexus Nic Salt collection, Mr Blue is available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, alongside a wide range of fruity, fizzy and icy blends.
